mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2% signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in UNRATE above 8.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days due to reduced labor market confidence and anticipated corporate profit declines.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative when UNRATE crosses above 8.5%, or t-test p > 0.05 showing no significant negative effect.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) above their 5-year averages signal economic expansion, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations to drive positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when both GDPC1 and INDPRO are above historical averages for 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in FEDFUNDS above 2% triggers negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as higher interest rates compress equity valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not negative when FEDFUNDS crosses above 2% in a tightening regime, or t-test p > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in INDPRO above its 5-year average signals robust supply-side expansion, enhancing corporate profits and equity valuations to drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive when INDPRO remains above average for 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 260 points triggers negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as investors anticipate inflation eroding real returns and corporate profit margins.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative when CPIAUCSL crosses above 260, or t-test p > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS falls below 1% and UNRATE declines below 8.5%, the combination signals easing monetary policy and labor market recovery, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when both FEDFUNDS <1% and UNRATE <8.5% simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: Both GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (housing demand) rising above their 5-year averages signal explosive demand across sectors, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST above 5-year averages
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST exceed historical averages for 6 months.
